Biyang Biyang Tonefancier series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Biyang DS-8 Mouse Published on June 30, 2008 Biyang Tonefancier series distortion pedal Information Biyang A combination using high quality American chipset with famous classic circuitry to create a round, thick tone with lots of clarity which it very similar to Tube sounding. DS-8 will make your guitar tone stand out and cut through the rest. Equipped with 3 modes; each mode offers a unique sounding via clipping of different diode. You will get a smooth and natural sounding from the Normal Mode, a higher output and thicker sound you will expect when you put two diodes in series from Turbo Mode and Extreme output and tons of sustain from the MAX Mode.
